explanation: Merge of main into the staleness pass. From main: From main (PR #84): Only the expression survey runbook and project guidance wording changed, describing how the gene page shows and opens each survey source. Adding or changing a dataset, its bundles, the expression catalog entries and their checks follow the same steps and commands as before. The rename work adds one step: a dataset that changes the nomenclature table also needs pnpm run build:search-names, which regenerates the search names and the rename groups from nomenclature.tsv; project guidance states the order, the --check guard and the rule tests. From this branch: From main: Registry fields, display labels and one survey source of reviewed studies were corrected; the dataset-change procedure, including the reviewed-reason step in build_registry_edits.mts and the expression-index rebuild for survey sources, is unchanged. The survey index was rebuilt with that procedure. From this branch: The expression survey wording leaves the dataset steps unchanged. The rename work adds one step: a dataset that changes the nomenclature table also needs pnpm run build:search-names, which regenerates the search names and the rename groups from nomenclature.tsv; project guidance states the order, the --check guard and the rule tests. Review fixes change survey tiles, handover and rename reading only; the dataset steps, bundles, catalog entries and their checks are unchanged.
